info.title: The Mighty Networks Admin API
info.description: An API for managing your Mighty Networks network

tags.name: Invites
tags.description: Invites allow you to invite users to your network

tags.name: Spaces
tags.description: Spaces are the organizational units within a Network where content and members are organized

tags.name: Rsvps
tags.description: Manage event RSVPs for your network

tags.name: Answers
tags.description: Manage member responses to custom fields

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description: Manage payment subscriptions - recurring payments from members to hosts for plans

tags.name: Purchases
tags.description: Manage purchases and subscriptions for your network

tags.name: Polls
tags.description: Polls and Questions allow members to share opinions and engage with each other

tags.name: Networks
tags.description: Networks are the top-level organizational unit under which other resources are nested

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Events are scheduled gatherings that members can RSVP to and engage with

tags.name: CustomFields
tags.description: Manage custom fields for your network

tags.name: AbuseReports

get.summary: Returns details of a specific event

200.description: Returns the event details

schema.description: Request body for updating an event

description.example: Join us for our monthly community meetup

starts_at.description: The date and time the event starts (ISO8601 format)

ends_at.description: The date and time the event ends (ISO8601 format)

time_zone.description: IANA timezone identifier for the event

restricted_event.description: Whether event is restricted to specific members (default: false)

post_in_feed.description: Whether event appears in the activity feed (default: true)

interval.description: Recurrence interval (e.g., 1 for every week, 2 for every 2 weeks)

by_days.description: Comma-separated list of recurrence day abbreviations (SU/MO/TU/WE/TH/FR/SA)

by_month_days.description: Comma-separated list of Nth day-of-the-month for recurrence

recurrence_count.description: How many times the event should recur

200.description: Returns the updated event
Returns the updated event
